craft_notes: Sthāyin: rule-joy. Close: prevailing. Rejected: 'ritual' — killed: rule kept; 'wins' flat — prevails kept.

lines: Thus worship told; in fire-rite too this way:
who worship-rule hath done, the seed recalls aright, prevails.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yajanam ākhyātam agnikārye 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījam prasiddhyati

reads_against.argmap: Worship told; even in fire this rule: remembering seed rightly, he succeeds.
c1_essence: Worship told; fire-rite rule; seed remembered rightly succeeds.
